title: Ghost Rider #25 (1992, Marvel) Double Sized Milestone Issue New Sealed
descriptionText:
This is a sealed, double-sized milestone issue of Ghost Rider #25 from 1992. The comic book features the characters of Ghost Rider (Danny Ketch) and Ghost Rider (Johnny Blaze) in the US Comics tradition of Marvel Comics. The issue is a first printing and comes boarded. 

The comic book is in English, with a single unit quantity sold as a single issue. It is a vintage item from the Modern Age (1992-Now) era and is perfect for collectors of action, superheroes, adventure, horror & sci-fi genres. The item is not personalized, inscribed or signed, but is a great addition to any comic book collection.
